description: This file provides an implementation of all PSR-17 HTTP Factory interfaces, including methods to create requests, responses, streams, URIs, and uploaded files, encapsulated within the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace.

classes.name: HttpFactory
classes.description: Final class implementing multiple PSR-17 factory interfaces for creating HTTP message components such as requests, responses, streams, URIs, and uploaded files.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates an instance of UploadedFileInterface from a stream, optional size, error code, filename, and media type.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface from a string content.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface from a file, opening the file with specified mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface from an existing resource.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequestInterface with specified HTTP method, URI, and server parameters.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a ResponseInterface with specified status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a RequestInterface with specified HTTP method and URI.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a UriInterface from a string URI.
